senses.gloss:
भैरव a. (-वी f.)
 [भीरोरिदम् अण्]
—1 Terrible, frightful, horrible, formidable; वेल्लद्भैरवरुण्डमुण्डनिकरैर्वीरो
 विधत्ते भुवम् U. 5. 6.
—2 Miserable.
—3 Relating to Bhairava.

भैरव + .{@-वः@}
—1 A form of Śiva (of which 8 kinds are enumerated).
—2 The sentiment of terror (भयानक).
—3 Fear, terror.
—4 N. of a musical mode (राग) calculated to excite emotions of fear or terror.
—5 A mountain.

भैरव + .{@-वी@}
—1 A form of the goddess Durgā. ˚चक्रम् a disc of the goddess भैरवी;
 प्रवृत्ते भैरवीचक्रे सर्वे वर्णा द्विजोत्तमाः । निवृत्ते भैरवीचक्रे सर्वे
 वर्णाः पृथक् पृथक् ॥ Utpattitantra.
—2 N. of a Rāgiṇī in the Hindu musical system.
—3 A girl of 12 or a young girl representing the goddess Durgā at the
 Durgā festival.
भैरव + -ईशः an epithet of Viṣṇu (or Śiva ?); so भैरवतर्जकः.

भैरव + -यातना a sort of purificatory torment inflicted by Bhairava of
 Benares on those who die there, to make their spirits fit for absorption
 into the Supreme Spirit.
